blocks.markdown: The Mac CI investigation found that rebuilding missing cached files caused most of the delay: the same source took about45 minutes cold and15 minutes with its cache. A reviewed correction is published in [PR183](https://github.com/ewq100/brn-rust/pull/183); required checks are queued. The completion-and-Undo checks are merged, with checks on the resulting main version still running.
Last refreshed: **20 October2026 at14:49 Europe/Tallinn**. This is a saved progress summary, not live activity.

- **Writing proposal checked:** one bounded account test produced exactly the requested wording change as a pending proposal. The original note, captured feedback and unrelated note stayed unchanged. A test-harness failure before account contact was diagnosed and corrected first. Actual Mac Apply and Undo remain queued; no further generation is needed.

**No decision is needed from you now.** PR183 awaits required hosted checks and normal integration; PR182’s resulting-main checks are still running. Optional Windows failures remain recorded. Actual Mac interaction stays in the18:00Tallinn batch.

operations.markdown: The reviewed Mac CI correction is in [PR 183](https://github.com/ewq100/brn-rust/pull/183), with required checks running. A focused repair is underway; no owner data or live AI call was used.
